aviation_incidents.headline: 義大利陸軍CH-47波士尼亞訓練中墮毀：EUFOR稱無平民傷亡、事故原因調查中
aviation_incidents.summary: 10月29日，一架隸屬歐盟駐波士尼亞維和部隊（EUFOR）的義大利陸軍CH-47契努克直升機，在波士尼亞北部布爾奇科市附近戈里济地區進行訓練飛行時墮毀，造成機上人員死傷。EUFOR確認，事故未造成基礎設施、建築或民用車輛損害，也沒有平民傷亡。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Italian Army CH-47 crashes during training in Bosnia; EUFOR reports no civilian casualties
aviation_incidents.summary_en: An Italian Army CH-47 Chinook helicopter assigned to the European Union Force (EUFOR) crashed during a training flight near the Gorice area by Brčko in northern Bosnia-Herzegovina on October 29, killing and injuring people on board. EUFOR confirmed the crash caused no damage to infrastructure, buildings or civilian vehicles, and no civilian casualties.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 曼谷蘇凡納布機場（BKK）跑道受損 華航CI840改隔日飛高雄
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華航表示，昨晚CI840曼谷飛往高雄航班因曼谷蘇凡納布機場（BKK）跑道受損影響航機運行；考量高雄機場（KHH）宵禁，航班改至隔日出發。航班準備起飛時，跑道疑似出現大面積凹陷。華航表示，航機經檢查確認安全無虞。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines reschedules CI840 after runway damage in Bangkok
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines said its CI840 flight from Bangkok to Kaohsiung was moved to the following day after damage to the runway at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) affected aircraft operations. The airline said Kaohsiung Airport (KHH)’s curfew was also taken into account. A large depression was suspected on the runway as the flight prepared to take off. China Airlines said the aircraft was inspected and found safe, and that it arranged meals, accommodation and transport for passengers before departure.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空與阿提哈德航空擴大哩程合作
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空宣佈與阿提哈德航空深化合作，合作範圍延伸至會員哩程計畫，推出雙向哩程兌換及累積服務。星宇航空表示，雙方會員可用累積哩程兌換對方航空公司營運航班的酬賓機票。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux Airlines and Etihad Airways Expand Mileage Partnership
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines announced that it is deepening its partnership with Etihad Airways and extending the cooperation to their member mileage programs. The airlines are introducing two-way mileage redemption and accrual services. Starlux said members of either program can use accumulated miles to redeem award tickets on flights operated by the other airline.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 蕭美琴提出三大支柱鞏固臺灣無人機供應鏈亞洲中心地位
taiwan_aviation.summary: 副總統蕭美琴在臺灣無人機國際論壇暨無人機國際學院開幕活動致詞，提出鞏固臺灣作為無人機民主供應鏈亞洲中心的三大支柱。她表示，臺灣的發展方向包括建立可信賴的非紅供應鏈、推動邊緣人工智慧與軟體定義創新，以及加強國際合作與無人機外交。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Hsiao Sets Out Three Pillars to Strengthen Taiwan’s Drone Supply Chain
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim set out three pillars for strengthening Taiwan’s position as an Asian hub for a democratic drone supply chain. She delivered the remarks at the Taiwan International Drone Forum and the opening event for the Global UAV Academy. The pillars she described are a trusted non-China supply chain, edge AI and software-defined innovation, and international cooperation and drone diplomacy.

international_aviation.headline: 衣索比亞接收首批俄製Su-35戰機、計畫引進S-400防空系統
international_aviation.summary: 衣索比亞已接收首批俄製蘇愷Su-35戰機，並計畫引進俄羅斯S-400防空系統。總理阿比10月28日在莫斯科出席俄非峰會期間，於X平台宣布這項消息，並表示衣索比亞合計將接收12架Su-35與4組S-400防空飛彈連，形容這是強化國家安全、事先嚇阻侵略的里程碑。戰機交付比約定時程提前一年，阿比感謝俄羅斯總統普丁協助加快交付；他未透露交易金額、S-400系統抵達時間，也未透露戰機與防空飛彈連的部署地點。
international_aviation.headline_en: Ethiopia receives first Russian Su-35 fighters and plans S-400 purchase, Abiy says
international_aviation.summary_en: Ethiopia has received its first Russian Sukhoi Su-35 fighter jets and plans to acquire Russia's S-400 air defense system, Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed announced on October 28, 2026, on X while in Moscow for the Russia-Africa Summit. He said Ethiopia will receive 12 Su-35s in total and four S-400 batteries, describing the acquisition as a milestone strengthening national security and deterring aggression in advance. The jets arrived a year ahead of schedule, and Abiy thanked Russian President Vladimir Putin for helping to expedite delivery. He did not disclose the deal's value, when the S-400 systems will arrive, or where the jets and missile batteries will be deployed.

international_aviation.headline: airBaltic擬裁約100名機師與200名空服員　個別通知自10月31日起開始
international_aviation.summary: airBaltic計畫在最新撙節措施中裁減約100名機師與約200名空服員，航空公司已向AeroTime證實此事；數字尚未定案，員工評估完成後仍可能變動。拉脫維亞航空工會於10月29日表示，約300名airBaltic員工將自10月31日起陸續得知自己是否保住工作。
international_aviation.headline_en: airBaltic plans to cut around 100 pilots and 200 cabin crew, with notices from October 31
international_aviation.summary_en: airBaltic plans to cut around 100 pilots and around 200 cabin crew members in its latest savings drive, the airline has confirmed to AeroTime. The numbers are not yet final and may change once staff assessments are complete. The Latvian Aviation Union (LAU) said on October 29 that around 300 airBaltic employees will start learning whether they will keep their jobs from October 31.

international_aviation.headline: GE核准NYCO渦輪油用於787發動機　法航逾36個月試飛完成驗證
international_aviation.summary: GE航太已核准NYCO的TURBONYCOIL600渦輪油用於GEnx-1B發動機，該型發動機裝於波音787客機。這項核准是與法航多年密切合作的成果；法航以多具發動機進行空中評估，歷時逾36個月。
international_aviation.headline_en: GE Aerospace qualifies NYCO turbine oil for GEnx-1B engines after Air France trials
international_aviation.summary_en: GE Aerospace has qualified NYCO's TURBONYCOIL® 600 turbine oil for its GEnx-1B engines, mounted on Boeing 787 aircraft. The qualification marks the culmination of several years of close collaboration with Air France, which conducted an in-flight evaluation campaign of TURBONYCOIL® 600 across multiple engines over a period of more than 36 months.

international_aviation.summary: 德國漢莎航空（Lufthansa）規劃於12月正式開航首條由空中巴士A350-1000廣體客機執飛的航線。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa to Launch First Airbus A350-1000 Route in December With New Cabins
international_aviation.summary_en: German airline Lufthansa is set to launch its first Airbus A350-1000 route in December, marking the debut of the aircraft type in its commercial fleet.
